title: Timetable Auto-Sync & Single-Row Topbar
releaseNotes: Automated Timetable Login Sync: Classes and coursework automatically restore from cloud backup immediately upon logging in or switching accounts.
Guest Schedule Preservation: Guest local schedules are safely preserved during sign-in transitions, preventing accidental data loss.
Single-Row Timetable Topbar: Cleanly unified Today, Weekly, Routines, Add Class, and More Options across a single organized topbar row.
